title: Dr Pixley kaSeme Street, Durban CBD (approx.): immigrant man beaten to death by about 50 people in anti-immigrant march, 22 Oct
summary: Police say an immigrant man was beaten to death by a group of about 50 people on Dr Pixley kaSeme Street in the Durban CBD on the morning of Thursday 22 October. According to KwaZulu-Natal police spokesperson Col Robert ...
story: Police say an immigrant man was beaten to death by a group of about 50 people on Dr Pixley kaSeme Street in the Durban CBD on the morning of Thursday 22 October. According to KwaZulu-Natal police spokesperson Col Robert Netshiunda, the group was marching on Dr Pixley kaSeme Street towards Maud Mfusi Street when two men split off and approached the man; about 50 people then assaulted him and he died. A murder case has been opened. A security guard in the area told GroundUp the group was out targeting immigrants and that the man was probably walking to work at around 7am. It happened during renewed anti-immigrant protests in Durban (GroundUp). On 23 October police said five men, aged 19 to 46, had been taken in for questioning in connection with this murder and other attacks on foreign nationals that week; police did not say whether they had been charged (IOL). The victim is not named here; police had not named him. Sources: GroundUp, 22 October; IOL, 23 October. The map point is approximate: the street is known, not the exact spot.
